product_overview: SocioSports Website is a responsive and scalable digital platform designed to unify India's sports ecosystem by connecting athletes, trainers, institutions, events, opportunities, and communities. It serves as a comprehensive sports networking and community engagement platform that provides an ecosystem overview, event listings, content hubs, and social impact initiatives.
core_goals: Design a mobile-first and fully responsive web platform that clearly positions SocioSports as India’s premier sports ecosystem.
Develop a scalable and modular architecture supporting high traffic and future feature enhancements.
Provide content-driven engagement modules including blogs, events, and community features to foster user interaction.
Enable SEO optimization and analytics integration to maximize reach and monitor user behavior.
Implement admin controls and CMS features for easy content moderation and scalability.
Ensure security, accessibility, and performance optimizations according to best practices.
Support phased execution with a clear plan for future expansions including jobs, identity management, and monetization.
key_features: Home page offering a sports networking and ecosystem overview focusing on athletes, trainers, and communities.
Events page featuring listings and detailed views of sports events and tournaments with vendor/stall booking capabilities.
Blog and Knowledge Hub with articles, podcasts, and athlete stories for content-driven engagement.
Mobile App promotion section with download links to drive app adoption.
About Us and Contact pages including event booking functionality.
Admin-ready and dashboard-capable structure with CMS for managing blogs, events, and content updates.
SEO-optimized, accessible, and performance-focused UI employing modern technology stack including React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
Integrated Google Analytics and conversion tracking for app downloads and inquiries.
user_flow_summary: Users land on the Home page to get an overview of the sports ecosystem and navigate to key sections.
Users explore Events page to view upcoming sports events, details, and book stalls or participate.
Users engage with the Blog page to read articles, listen to podcasts, and view athlete stories.
Users visit the Mobile App Promotion section to download the app, tracked via conversion analytics.
Admin users access CMS dashboards to create, edit, and moderate content like blogs, events, and community posts.
Visitors use the Contact page to inquire or book events, triggering appropriate backend workflows.
validation_criteria: Website is fully responsive and optimized for mobile and desktop devices.
Core pages such as Home, Events, Blog, About Us, and Contact meet functional requirements and UX standards.
Feature sections including event listings, blog articles, social impact modules, and app promotion are implemented and validated.
SEO and analytics tracking are configured and demonstrate accurate data capturing.
Admin CMS functionalities support content moderation and scalable content management without errors.
Security protocols and accessibility standards (WCAG) are verified through testing.
Performance benchmarks meet fast load and optimized asset delivery requirements.
Post-launch support and documentation are complete, enabling smooth handover and maintenance.
